thread:
elena: Quick follow-up from last night's inference latency incident — want to lock owners/timelines for the postmortem action grid.
jonah: Thanks — summary pls?
elena: Short: sustained 99th p95 token latency spikes between 03:12-03:45 UTC, autoscaler didn't kick until queue backlog hit 600. Error budget burn ~4% for that day.
priya: Noted. I think the dashboard alerting threshold is too coarse (single panel for p95).
samir: Also saw repeated GPU hot-swap events on node pool B, looks like a recurring pattern from Feb incidents.
elena: Proposed split actions: 1) dashboard + alerts (owner: jonah, ETA: 2d); 2) autoscaler policy tweak + test (owner: samir, ETA: 3d); 3) canary routing for large requests (owner: priya, ETA: 5d); 4) add golden prompt evals to detect perf regressions (owner: elena, ETA: 7d).
jonah: I'm on dashboard. Will create a new panel tracking p50/p95/p99 by model+route and a separate errorbudget burn-rate graph. Will also add a bot alert when 5-min burn > 1%. ETA EOD Wed.
priya: For canary routing, proposal: route requests with sequence length > 2048 to dedicated pool or lower-batch mode. Need a config change and perf test. I'll draft RFC and perf job. ETA next Tuesday.
samir: Autoscaler: lower scale-up threshold from 80% to 65% CPU+queue heuristic, and enable immediate short-burst nodes for 2-mins. I'll run a simulated load test to ensure no oscillation. ETA 3 business days.
oncall-bot: Incident #INC-2024-432 created, postmortem ticket PM-987 attached.
elena: For recurring GPU hot-swap pattern, assign infra triage to samir + infra team. Please add historical heatmap to the SRE dashboard so we can correlate kernel OOMs.
jonah: Adding the Grafana query now. Quick snippet I'm using:
```
sum by(model, route) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])))
```
priya: Also adding a synthetic that ramps seq lengths every 6h to catch long-tail.
samir: Will coordinate with infra on driver updates and node pool health checks. If driver patch isn't stable, we fallback to node pool C for critical routes.
elena: OK owners noted. Let's also set a temporary SLO tweak for the affected route: relax 99th latency SLO from 250ms -> 350ms for a 72h window while we validate autoscale changes so we don't burn error budget aggressively. Who can approve?
jonah: I can sign off on the temporary SLO for the route we manage. I'll update the SLO config and annotate change in the SLO log.
priya: I'll communicate this to product and CS (short note) — want to avoid alerts hitting customers.
elena: Great. Add timeline to PM-987 and update the action grid: each row should have owner, ETA, status, PR link, and test evidence.
samir: I'll post load test results to the PM ticket and tag @elena.
jonah: PR for dashboard panels created: https://git.internal/r/grafana/pulls/1123 (draft).
priya: RFC for canary routing: https://docs.internal/rfcs/486 (WIP).
elena: Recurring incident note — add "recurrence" tag on postmortem so we can roll these into a monthly recurrence SWAT.
oncall-bot: Reminder: postmortem due in 72h.
jonah: Quick question: do we want a separate alert for cache warmup failures? That was visible in logs.
elena: Yes. Add a "cache-warmup-fail" alert to the new dashboard. Priority low.
priya: I'll draft comms and schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to handoff owners. 10:30 UTC ok?
elena: 10:30 works. I'll create calendar invite and include the PM + infra leads.
samir: 👍 will be there.
jonah: :thumbsup:
elena: Thanks all — will update PM-987 with action grid + SLO temporary change after the sync.
